reward: One unchanged short official terminal-success prompt plus native task instruction. F=(official expected_score-1)/4; no per-task rubrics or simulator truth input.

qualification.first_execution: First planned eight OpenDrawer episodes qualify real three-view recording/scoring, counted within the50; no extra smoke.
qualification.native_headroom: Retain original5%..70% native headroom rule; report counts/intervals per task.

qualification.failure: Retain all outcomes. No automatic task replacement, sampler tuning, prompt tuning or favorable-task selection from Flora scores.

evaluation.pairing: Same frozen task/constructor/layout/native sampler seeds across all policies; TRAIN/DEV/qualification/final banks disjoint.
evaluation.statistics: Per-task Wilson95% rate intervals and paired discordant outcomes/exact McNemar comparison.50is initial precision, not guaranteed power for small effects; any extension gets a prospective finite stage/stopping rule before further outcomes.
evaluation.OOD_isolation: No OOD gradients, reward calibration, task selection, checkpoint selection or DEV stopping.
